blocks.text: Maymay Entrata is set to represent the Philippines in the upcoming game show “Hong Kong Unlocked,” alongside entertainment personalities from Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore. The six-episode series, produced by TVN Asia, will follow the four cast members as they explore popular tourist attractions and lesser-known destinations in Hong Kong. Entrata will be joined by Indonesian personality Gabriel Prince, Malaysian personality Moses Wong and Singaporean personality Chow Jia Hui. According to TVN Asia, the four cast members were selected through a competitive audition process, with their energy and adventurous personalities among the qualities considered for the show.
